This plot is not mine, it is rented, so I do not want to spend too much cash on it. I have no schooling and I just do what my father did and what my neighbors do — I put some manure from my cattle because I have it at home, and I keep my own wheat seed from last harvest. Fertilizer from the cooperative is expensive and I only have 0.16 hectare here, one bag of DAP is too much for such a small piece, but my neighbors use a little so I will buy a small share and put maybe half a bag on this plot. I cannot irrigate, I wait for the meher rain, and I will weed with my wife myself, maybe call my brother for one or two days at harvest.
